title: Solaris user configuration
description: Trusted user-level Solaris configuration. Project repositories cannot broaden these settings.

profile.description: Session sandbox profile. Defaults to inspect.

backend.description: Sandbox backend selection. Defaults to auto.

godot.description: Trusted user-level Godot installation configuration. Project files cannot select or broaden executables.

activeInstallation.description: Installation id used by default. Must reference a configured or discovered installation.

path.description: Absolute path to a Godot executable (or macOS .app bundle). Relative paths are rejected.

editionHint.description: User-supplied edition hint. A hint only, never an authoritative result.

discoverOnPath.description: Whether fixed-name PATH discovery is enabled. Defaults to true.

quality.description: Trusted user-level development-quality configuration. An untrusted repository cannot alter these settings.

reviewProvider.description: Optional provider profile used for the independent change reviewer. Must reference an existing configured provider; a missing profile fails clearly and never silently falls back to an unrelated provider. Defaults to the active development provider profile.
